defects.defect: The amount check in src/refund.js compares the refund with what the order is worth and never looks at what the order has had back before, which the untouched src/refund-store.js keeps. Let the provider settle 3000 cents of a 5000 cent order after a dispute and then give a 3000 cent line back: both go through, because each is under the order total on its own, and the shop pays out 6000 cents.

defects.defect: src/handlers/refund.js does its work without asking src/seen.js whether the event has been through already, which the payment handler beside it does. src/webhook.js runs a handler that throws again, so a refund event whose mail goes out while the mailer is down lands on the books twice, 4000 cents for a 2000 cent event.

defects.defect: refundShares in src/refund-lines.js works out each line's part of the order discount in floating point and rounds each on its own, instead of the exact split src/money.js already has and src/orders.js already uses. A discount of 100 cents over three lines of 1000 cents each takes only 99 cents off, so giving the whole order back pays out a cent more than the order is worth.
